subject: Film & Cinema
title: Stanley Kubrick: The Obsessive Perfectionist
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Stanley Kubrick: The Obsessive Perfectionist.

hook.text: Kubrick made Shelley Duvall do 127 takes of one scene in The Shining. He wanted perfection.

buildup.text: Every Kubrick film explored a different genre — war, sci-fi, horror, period drama — and mastered it.

discovery.text: 2001: A Space Odyssey predicted video calls, AI, and tablets decades before they existed.

twist.text: His obsessive control alienated actors and crews, but the results were undeniable.

climax.text: Kubrick made only 13 films in 46 years. Nearly all are considered masterpieces.

punchline.text: Fewer films. Higher standards. Permanent legacy.

quiz.question: How many films did Kubrick direct in his career?
